2.title: Technical Recruiter
2.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

Technical Recruiter

Compass is looking for a Technical Recruiter who will drive the Company’s talent acquisition strategy for our growing teams across Engineering, Data, and Product. As our Technical Recruiter, you’ll partner with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition to develop, drive, and manage sourcing/recruiting strategies for our technical positions. In addition, you will assist in developing and promoting the Compass culture internally and externally.

Please note that this is an in-office role.

At Compass You Will:

• Manage and drive the full recruitment life cycle by sourcing, reviewing resumes, coordinating screenings and interviews, and assisting in determining the suitability of applicants in various departments for employment

• Work with Compass hiring managers to better understand each department’s needs and screen incoming applicants quickly and effectively

• Proactively source active and passive candidates through employee referrals, networking, internal databases, and innovative research tactics

• Communicate with candidates professionally and be immediately responsive

• Promote the Compass brand and use creativity to attract and market the Company to qualified and strong candidates

What We're Looking For:

• 3+ years of experience recruiting and sourcing engineers

• Experience managing technical candidate pipelines

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Meticulous attention to detail and organizational skills

• B.A. or B.S. with a strong academic record

• Must be able to multi-task and manage a robust/full pipeline with efficiency and constant attention

• High level of interpersonal skills and strong ability to engage both active and passive candidates

• Comfort leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve sourcing, research, outreach, and recruiting workflows; curiosity and willingness to experiment with new tools and approaches

• Considerable skill in interviewing techniques

• Experience with Greenhouse (or other relevant Applicant Tracking Systems) and LinkedIn Recruiter

• Proficiency in a variety of computer software applications, especially Google Suite

Compensation: The base pay range for this position is $120,000-$130,000; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses and restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.

Perks that You Need to Know About:

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

Do your best work, be your authentic self.

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

Notice for California Applicants

Los Angeles County Fair Chance Notice

5.title: Recruiting Coordinator
5.description: Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it. OUR MISSION True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground. OUR VALUES Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity. What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results. It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together. BENEFITS & PERKS * Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success. *Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles YOUR MISSION True Anomaly is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Recruiting Coordinator to play a key role in shaping our hiring experience. In this role, you’ll own the coordination of interviews across all departments, ensuring every candidate interaction reflects True Anomaly’s high standards of excellence and speed. You’ll partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and interview teams to drive an efficient, organized, and candidate-focused process. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving logistical challenges, and is motivated by creating structure and consistency within a growing team. This role reports directly to the Head of Talent and offers opportunities for career growth within Talent Acquisition and People Operations. RESPONSIBILITIES Coordinate and schedule interviews across all roles, ensuring alignment with business priorities and a seamless candidate experience Manage candidate communications - collecting availability, sending confirmations, and handling changes or logistics updates Ensure interview details, rooms, and video links are accurate and prepared for each session Greet onsite candidates, coordinate office tours, and serve as their main point of contact during visits Partner with Recruiters, Hiring Managers, and cross-functional teams to enable smooth interview execution Support interviewer readiness by maintaining scheduling resources and training materials Identify and implement improvements to scheduling efficiency and candidate experience Support in data management and provide regular updates on hiring activity, scheduling and candidate feedback metrics Additional support areas included but not limited to: recruiting operations activities, preboarding and onboarding tasks, and attending recruiting events QUALIFICATIONS 1+ years of experience in a Recruiting Coordinator, Talent Acquisition, or HR Operations role. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high attention to detail. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE Experience handling confidential information with professionalism and discretion. Proficiency with Greenhouse (or similar ATS) and Microsoft Office Suite. Collaborative, proactive, and solutions-oriented mindset. COMPENSATION Base Salary: $70,000-$85,000 Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS Work Location: Successful candidates will be located near our headquarters in Centennial, CO and are expected to be in the office 5 days/week. Work environment: is in a standard office, working at a desk. This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know. To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice .

11.title: Registered Nurse – Navigator
11.company: The Copper River Family of Companies
11.description:
Coho Integrated Solutions is seeking a qualified Registered Nurse – Navigator to support referral management, discharge planning, and VA-to-DoD patient transfer coordination at the 96th Medical Group at Eglin Air Force Base, Florida.

The Registered Nurse – Navigator will serve as a clinical liaison between the 96th Medical Group and the Eglin Community-Based Outpatient Clinic, coordinating emergency department, inpatient transfers, outpatient referrals, discharge planning, and related clinical and administrative activities. The position requires extensive coordination with healthcare providers, VA personnel, TRICARE representatives, patients, families, and other members of the interdisciplinary healthcare team.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

• Serve as the primary clinical liaison between the 96th Medical Group and the Eglin Community-Based Outpatient Clinic.

• Coordinate VA-to-DoD patient transfers, emergency department transfers, inpatient placements, and outpatient referral services.

• Support safe and timely discharge planning, including coordination of durable medical equipment, home health care, specialty referrals, follow-up appointments, and community resources.

• Screen and process specialty care referrals, authorizations, Right of First Refusal (ROFR) requests, and related referral-management activities.

• Conduct medical necessity, preauthorization, medical appeal, utilization review, and insurance-related activities as required.

• Coordinate with VA providers, 96th Medical Group physicians, specialists, supervisors, receiving units, utilization management, case management, and social work personnel.

• Apply evidence-based utilization and discharge planning tools, including InterQual and Milliman guidelines, as appropriate.

• Monitor admission appropriateness, length of stay, discharge criteria, and transfer requirements to minimize avoidable delays in patient care.

• Educate patients, families, providers, and staff regarding discharge planning, referrals, transfers, post-discharge care, and available resources.

• Coordinate with third-party payers and TRICARE Managed Care Support Contractors to support authorization and reimbursement requirements.

• Maintain accurate documentation and referral-management records using MHS GENESIS and authorized VA systems.

• Participate in quality improvement initiatives, committees, working groups, training, and process improvement activities designed to improve referral and transition-of-care processes.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

• Citizenship:

• U.S. citizenship is required for this contract position

• Education and Licensure:

• Graduate of an Associate Degree in Nursing or Bachelor of Science in Nursing program from a college or university accredited by the Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE).

• Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification in accordance with applicable contract requirements.

• Current, active, valid, and unrestricted Registered Nurse license from any U.S. state or territory or the District of Columbia.

• Required Experience:

• Minimum of three years of clinical nursing experience.

• At least one year of experience within the last two years as a Registered Nurse in inpatient care, care coordination, discharge planning, or case management.

• Required Skill and Competencies:

• Extensive knowledge of the Military Health System or Veterans Health Administration.

• Knowledge of nursing care principles, healthcare practices, TRICARE concepts, referral management, discharge planning, and care coordination.

• Working knowledge of medical necessity, utilization review, insurance processes, and healthcare reimbursement.

• Knowledge of relevant requirements and standards affecting emergency transfers and discharge planning, including EMTALA.

• Ability to analyze clinical and administrative information and make appropriate decisions within the scope of professional nursing practice.

• Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with physicians, nurses, administrative personnel, patients, families, and external healthcare organizations.

• Proficiency with computer applications and electronic healthcare information systems.

• Work Schedule & On-Call Requirements:

• Duty hours are scheduled according to department requirements. Standard services are generally provided between 0600 and 1800, Monday through Friday, with a 40-hour workweek. Staggered schedules may be established to support mission requirements

• The Physical Therapist participates in an on-call rotation that includes Saturday and Sunday coverage from 0800–1600 once per month, as well as two federal holidays and two family days per year from 0800–1600

• Physical Requirements:

• The employee must be capable of performing the physical duties associated with professional nursing and healthcare coordination within a medical treatment facility. Duties may require standing, walking, moving throughout the facility, and interacting directly with patients and healthcare personnel. The employee must be able to perform assigned duties while maintaining patient safety, confidentiality, and professional standards.

About Copper River & The Native Village of Eyak:

Owned by the Native Village of Eyak (NVE), a federally recognized Alaska Native Tribe, the Copper River Family of Companies are a collection of entities that deliver a complementary set of solutions and services to support the diverse missions and requirements of our clients. Proud participants of the Small Business Administration’s (SBA) 8(a) Business Development Program since 2006, our companies consist of both current and graduation SBA 8(a) entities. It is our collective purpose to support the Tribe and diversify the NVE’s ability to facilitate economic advancement.

The income generated from our companies helps the Native Village of Eyak fund health and social services, economic development, natural resource/environmental education, jobs, job training, and other benefits to the NVE in a manner that is consistent with Alaskan Native cultural values and traditions.

Copper River’s Culture

The Copper River Family of Companies has a positive, supportive, and thriving culture. At the foundation of our culture is a focus on collaboration. No matter your role or which operating company you work for, we are ONE TEAM working toward the same goals for our customers and for our collective owner- The Native Village of Eyak. How we treat each other is just as important as the work we deliver.

Benefits

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Flexible Spending Account - healthcare and dependent care

• Health Savings Account - high deductible medical plan

• Retirement 401(k) with employer match

• Open leave policy and paid holidays

• Additional benefits including tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more!

Note : Benefits are offered based on employment classification and applicable contract requirements. Eligibility may vary by position.

Disclaimer:

The Copper River Family of Companies provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

13.title: Seasonal Sales Associate (part-time)- Perry Ellis
13.description:

The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiaries owns and licenses nationally and with a brand portfolio of over 40 Brands domestically and internationally recognized brands including: Perry Ellis®, Original Penguin® by Munsingwear®, Laundry by Shelli Segal®, Rafaella®, Cubavera®, Ben Hogan®, Savane®, Grand Slam®, John Henry®, Manhattan®, Axist® and Farah®. The Company enhances its roster of brands by licensing trademarks from third parties, including: Nike® for swimwear, and Callaway®, PGA TOUR®, and Jack Nicklaus® for golf apparel.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Perry Ellis is a clothing company of Menswear designer & retail chain featuring tailored apparel, from suits to casual wear & accessories. Perry Ellis’ passion and OPTIMISM for living life to the fullest is instilled in the culture, written into its history, and sewn into every product.

SUMMARY:

• Follow all operational policies and procedures.

• Follows guidance from management to execute visual standards, recovery and replenishment.

REQUIREMENTS:

• Energetic and positive attitude

• Retail experience is preferred.

• Strong verbal and written skills.

• Strong interpersonal communication and customer service skills.

• Customer service-oriented (outgoing, friendly, and personable with a positive attitude)

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the company's commitment to equal employment opportunities.

We encourage you to read and understand our Privacy Policy here .

28.title: Customer Success Account Manager - Basic
28.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Mid-Market Account Manager, you are your customers' trusted advisor and their long-term partner at Samsara, from adoption to value realization and through to renewal. You develop deep knowledge of the Samsara platform and the technical acumen to advise customers on how to customize the platform for their fleet and unique challenges. You pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, building the relationship, driving adoption, and ensuring customers realize measurable value from the product.

That trusted-advisor relationship is what earns you the right to a productive commercial conversation at renewal. Because you understand the value the customer has been getting out of Samsara, you are the right person to lead the ROI and value conversation, negotiate terms, and close a renewal that is a win for both the customer and Samsara. You own the renewal from end to end, minimizing financial attrition and locking in the most favorable terms.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This is a remote role open to candidate residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You thrive the most when solving problems : Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

• You are a natural relationship builder : Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

• You are the architect of your own career : If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.

• You want to be with the best : At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

• Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.

• Demonstrate a willingness to learn, investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues for customers.

• Build trusted relationships with operational and executive stakeholders, and become their long-term partner at Samsara.

• Drive adoption and measurable value by leading strategic customer engagements, product consultations, and value check-ins that remove barriers and help customers get the most out of Samsara.

• Own your book of Mid-Market customers from adoption through Renewal: Proactively identify, forecast, escalate and mitigate renewal risk.

• Identify expansion opportunities through deep customer relationships and product conversations, uncovering where additional Samsara solutions can drive more value.

• Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.

• Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.

• Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 2 to 5+ years in a customer-facing role such as renewals, account management, or sales, ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics supporting or working with technical products.

• A track record of consistent quota over-achievement.

• Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.

• Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively and empathetically with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders: Executives, Sales, Product, Support, and day-to-day users of our software.

• Strong communication, presentation, and organizational skills.

• Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.

• Comfort with a rapidly changing, high-growth environment.

• Bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Strong bias towards action , has the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards.

• AI First : Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.

• Technical Proficiency : Experience with building deep knowledge of a suite of technical products (bonus points if familiar with integrating hardware with software solutions).

• Industry Knowledge : Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$72,888 — $110,250 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

38.title: Sales Consultant
38.description:
What You’ll Do:

Are you a driven sales professional looking for an opportunity where your effort, ambition, and performance directly influence your earning potential?

At Century Complete, we’re passionate about helping families achieve their dream of homeownership while building communities people are proud to call home. As a Sales Consultant, you’ll play a critical role in guiding customers through one of life’s most important decisions while building a rewarding career with a company focused on growth, innovation, and excellence. Century’s mission is to build homes, communities, and careers that people are proud to call their own.

This is an opportunity for a conversion-focused professional who thrives in a high-volume sales environment, generating business, and delivering results. Through a competitive bonus structure, your unlimited earning potential is directly tied to your performance, making this an ideal role for individuals with an entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for performance-based compensation sales.

Many customers use our Buy Online feature, creating opportunities for virtual engagement. This position is based in a model home within one of our new communities or in a Studio Office. As a Sales Consultant, you will help keep our More Home, Less Money® mission moving forward.

What We Offer:

• Competitive compensation with bonus opportunities that reward performance.

• The ability to directly influence your earning potential through your initiative, effort, and results.

• The opportunity to help buyers achieve homeownership while building a meaningful and rewarding career.

• A collaborative culture built on teamwork, ownership, trust, urgency, and excellence.

• Professional growth opportunities with a company committed to developing careers and recognizing success.

Your Key Responsibilities Include:

• Develop and execute strategies to generate new buyer traffic through networking, realtor engagement, referrals, community outreach, and local marketing efforts.

• Manage, qualify, and convert inbound leads while proactively identifying new sales opportunities.

• Maintain consistent and accurate use of Salesforce to manage leads, track the sales pipeline, and document customer interactions.

• Own the customer journey from initial inquiry through contract, construction updates, and closing.

• Assist prospective buyers throughout the home purchasing process, from prospect to contract and closing.

• Leverage open house events to build pipelines, referrals, and sales conversions.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with local real estate professionals, lenders, and community stakeholders.

• Own the customer journey and drive a seamless homebuying experience by coordinating with buyers, real estate professionals, Century Complete teams, and financing partners to keep transactions progressing smoothly toward a successful closing.

• Communicate internally and externally regarding buyer contracts, closing documentation, and mortgage processing to help ensure required information is received, and transactions remain on track for the scheduled closing date.

• Take ownership of the sales studio experience, leveraging marketing assets, community presentation, and operational excellence to maximize customer engagement and sales opportunities.

• Operate your business with a high level of professionalism by maintaining accurate records, managing critical documentation, and executing every transaction with precision.

• Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and closing goals.

• Participate in regular studio, sales, and company meetings.

• Foster lasting homeowner relationships that generate active promoters, referrals and support customer satisfaction.

• Perform other duties as needed or assigned.

What Makes You Successful:

• Entrepreneurial, results-driven professional with a proven ability to generate leads, build relationships, convert opportunities, and consistently exceed sales goals.

• Skilled in consultative selling, objection management, and delivering an exceptional customer experience built on trust and credibility.

• Thrives in a dynamic, goal-oriented environment with strong adaptability, resilience, and a sense of urgency.

Classification: Full-Time, permanent

Who We Are
Saxbys® is a hospitality company fueled by our rave-worthy menu, driven by its mission to Make Life Better®, and fiercely dedicated to social impact in the communities it serves. But Saxbys’ greatest resource of all? Our people. We’re not looking for employees: we’re looking for teammates. We’re not hoping to hire you for a job: we’re hoping to help build your career.

Saxbys is a national education company that operates “For Students, By Students” cafes on college campuses. We build individualized academic partnerships with universities to provide exceptional, paid, experiential learning opportunities for their students. The Saxbys Experiential Learning Platform (E.L.P.)® is founded on the belief that young people should be empowered and prepared to mold the business movement of the future.

Job Summary
The Area Operations Manager (AOM) leads three Saxbys cafes in New York: Marist University in Poughkeepsie, and Siena and UAlbany in the Albany area. The AOM makes sure each cafe succeeds in all Three Pillars (team development, community leadership, and financial management). Success in this role comes from a passion for developing, coaching, and supporting the Student Cafe Executive Officers (SCEOs) who run each cafe every semester. The AOM is the operations leader all three campus partners rely on, and the role calls for a proactive person with a whatever-it-takes attitude who is ready for the varied day-to-day opportunities and challenges of leading multiple campuses.

Learn more about Saxbys E.L.P. by clicking here

What You Will Own

• Coaching & Development: Train and develop the Student Chief Officers at Marist, Siena, and UAlbany to lead operations at their respective campus cafes each semester.

• Talent Pipeline: Interview and hire across all three cafes to keep each team fully staffed for operational demands, and identify and develop exceptional talent for leadership roles.

• Cafe Standards: Stay up to date on all cafe operations so you can train and coach on every cafe role. Make SOPs easy for team members to access and maintain operational integrity by making sure every step is followed. Make sure SCEOs follow progressive discipline policies and issue Coaching & Counseling forms when necessary, and advise and assist with involuntary terminations. Hold SCEOs accountable for consistent communication with their teams.

• Guest Experience: Conduct regular quality assurance checks at each cafe, audit performance to find and correct inconsistencies in execution, and keep a culture of hospitality strong across all three campuses.

• Financial Management: Review, give feedback on, and approve weekly schedules so labor hours match demand and stay within budget. Coach SCEOs on how to read and act on Profit & Loss statements, and present and defend each cafe’s P&L during reviews. Produce and assign Labor Models for all three cafes.

• PARS & Inventory: Ensure accurate inventory counts, and review and approve Orders & PARS Inventory Worksheets for Marist, Siena, and UAlbany.

• Partner Management: Represent Saxbys as the main point of contact for each campus’s partners, including Dining Service Partner leads, Auxiliary Services, and Residential Life, so day-to-day operations run smoothly. Keep each Campus Resource Guide up to date.

• Cafe Openings: Lead cafe setup and grand openings as the Operations lead, working closely with all departments to ensure a successful start.

• Local and Competitive Marketplace: Stay current on industry trends, local competitors, and community news around each campus that could affect the business, so you can manage cafe operations proactively.

Who You Will Support

• Marketing: Share intel on campus opportunities through research and conversations with partners. Help each SCEO refine their Campus Marketing Plan so efforts go to the highest-ROI opportunities, and make sure key dates and deliverables are executed.

• Head of Area Operations: Assist with academic partners, requested reports, and special projects.

• Recruiting: Nominate, vet, and support internal student candidates in the SCEO pipeline at all three campuses, conduct final interviews, and communicate hiring needs clearly to Campus Recruiters. Take part in initiatives that grow the candidate pool.

Who You Will Supervise
This position oversees 3 direct reports: the Student Cafe Executive Officers at Marist University, Siena, and UAlbany.

What Success Looks Like

• Marist, Siena, and UAlbany each operate at or above budgeted revenue

• Each cafe operates at or above budgeted NOI

• 30%+ of each cafe’s team members are Team Leads

• 100% of SCEOs are hired by March 31 for the fall semester and by October 31 for the spring semester

What Else Is Required

• Support, exhibit, and promote Saxbys Mission and Core Values in all daily activities

• 2+ years of proven experience leading and developing talent in a customer-facing environment, OR at least 6 months as a Saxbys Student Leader

• Food & Beverage or Retail experience is a plus (not required)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Outstanding passion for hospitality and servant leadership

• Experience managing teams and processes effectively

• Ability to travel up to 80% of the time, including regular trips between the Albany-area campuses and Poughkeepsie (about 75 miles apart)

• Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation

• Physical requirements:

• Able to stand, walk, and smile for extended periods of time

• Able to stoop and kneel

• Able to push, pull, lift, or carry up to 35 lbs

• Able to climb up and down ladders, stairs, and ramps

Job Description

Job Title: IT Service Desk Specialist – Level I
Location: Pensacola, FL (on-site)
Supporting: The Defense Health Agency (DHA) **Secret Security Clearance**

Overview

CompTech Computer Technologies is seeking an IT Service Desk Specialist – Level I to provide technical support in support of the Defense Health Agency (DHA). This position serves as a first point of contact for end users experiencing technical issues with client-level hardware and software. The ideal candidate will have a strong customer-service mindset, hands-on troubleshooting experience, and the ability to diagnose and resolve common technical issues while accurately documenting incidents and following established support procedures.

Scope of Work

Key responsibilities include:

• Serve as a first point of contact for customers requiring technical assistance with hardware, software, and other client-level IT issues.

• Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical problems in accordance with established procedures and service desk processes.

• Provide Tier I support for common workstations, applications, hardware, software, and user-access issues.

• Create, update, track, and document incidents and service requests within the designated ticketing system.

• Accurately document troubleshooting steps, actions taken, resolutions, and relevant customer information.

• Escalate incidents that cannot be resolved at the Level I support tier to the appropriate technical support team.

• Follow established incident-management and problem-resolution procedures.

• Communicate clearly and professionally with customers throughout the troubleshooting and resolution process.

• Provide timely status updates and ensure customers understand next steps when an issue requires escalation.

• Maintain a customer-focused approach while supporting users with varying levels of technical proficiency.

• Adhere to applicable security policies, procedures, and organizational standards.

• Two (2) years of progressive experience in IT technical support, help desk, service desk, desktop support, or a related discipline demonstrating the required level of proficiency.

• Demonstrated experience troubleshooting client-level hardware and software issues.

• Experience using a ticketing or IT service management system to log, track, document, and manage technical support requests.

• Ability to follow established technical procedures and incident-resolution processes.

• Strong customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to clearly communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical users.

• Ability to meet the security and background investigation requirements associated with the position.

Additional certifications relevant to technical support, desktop support, or DoD cyber workforce requirements are a plus.

62.title: Senior Software Engineer II
62.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Recovering entrepreneur? Frustrated with bureaucracy? Want to write the roadmap, not inherit one?

We're hiring across multiple levels and verticals. The nice thing about growing 30%+ at ~$2B ARR is that we need great engineers everywhere, and we have the room to shape the role around the right person. You build like a founder. We give you the platform to do it at scale.

About the role:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

• You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

• You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

• You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

• You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will:

• Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

• Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

• Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

• Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

• Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

• Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

• Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

• Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

• Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

• Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has:

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before . We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Telematics Installer at our rental facility in Raleigh, NC , and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. Telematics Installers are responsible for installing and repairing our telematics system and devices.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours. (This role is subject to on-call scheduling with additional compensation provided)

Primary Responsibilities

• Install our telematics system and devices on vehicles, construction equipment, heavy equipment, and customer assets

• Must be able to operate machinery at times during installation for testing purposes

• Confidently remove and replace ignition systems without custom keypad and controller then integrate communication between keypad and telematics systems

• Work through a variety of installation scenarios ranging from basic (Power, ignition, ground) to complex (requiring custom wiring harnesses when accessing the CAN network of both vehicles and equipment)

• Identify and resolve problems, gather and analyze information and develop alternative solutions if required

• Travel to client sites or various EquipmentShare rental yards through the region for installation cases

• Serve as an advocate for the EquipmentShare platform of solutions and brand while on the job and in the field

• Occasionally work outside of business hours and on weekends

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you , and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special .

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent)

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications:

• Proficient with iphone/ mobile phone technology and basic computer navigation

Required Skills/Abilities:

• High school diploma or equivalent (Trade School Certificate preferred)

• Mechanical aptitude, good with your hands and with tools

• Hard-working, eager to learn and mechanically inclined

• Experience in a related field, e.g., electrician, HVAC tech, car audio installer, etc

• Mobile Electronics Installer

• Automotive Electronics Technician

• 12V Technician

• Prior experience in the telematics industry is not necessary; we will train you

• Own tools; a few specialty tools will be provided

• Hard worker with excellent attention to detail

• Clean driving record and be able to pass a background check

• Must be open to traveling within a 250 mile radius of our local branch for up to a week at a time

• Must be able to drive, maneuver in tight spaces, bend, squat, walk long distances and lift more than 25 lb

• Telematics Installers may be required to be clean shaven in order to enter worksites for EquipmentShare customers who have this requirement

• This is a safety sensitive position and any offer of employment will be contingent on passing a 10 panel drug screen

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.

112.title: Senior Account Executive
112.description: About the Opportunity What would you build if you had the freedom to set your own schedule, choose who you work with, and grow your income without a ceiling? As a Senior Account Executive (known to N2 as Area Directors), you’d launch and lead a Stroll publication in your market, using a proven business model with the training, tools, and national support to help you succeed. It's freedom, built on a plan. Stroll is the magazine neighbors look forward to, celebrating the people, stories, and businesses that make a community feel like home. Imagine being the person who brings it to life in your area. Position Summary We're seeking an Area Director to launch, grow, and lead a Stroll publication in your local market. Area Directors operate as a local publisher: building partnerships with local business owners, featuring residents and their stories, and growing a recurring revenue stream. If accepted, you’d follow a clear, step-by-step launch plan. Your first months focus on establishing your territory and building your client base. From there, you’d grow a business with your name on it. This hybrid opportunity combines in-person relationship building with work from your home office. Who You Are You want more control over your time, your income, and your future, and you're ready to build toward it. You're driven to win, and you take initiative without waiting to be told what's next. You value a proven plan and will follow a system that works while making it your own. You're a natural relationship-builder with consultative sales instincts. You're curious and coachable, always looking to sharpen your skills and learn from people who've done it before. You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like the life you want to build, we want to hear from you. What Area Directors Do Meet with local business owners to build long-term advertising partnerships. Help local businesses reach the homeowners in the neighborhoods you serve. Connect with residents to capture authentic stories that reflect the heart of each community. Manage your territory, sales pipeline, and publication operations using N2's proven tools and processes. Partner with N2's national team for design, production, training, and ongoing support. Lead your publication's growth as the face of Stroll in your market. What Area Directors Love Freedom over your time: Build your workday around your life, not the other way around. A proven path: Step-by-step training and repeatable systems mean you're never guessing what comes next. Something you own: Build a business and a reputation in your market. A name in your community: Become the trusted connector between local businesses and the neighborhoods they serve. A team behind you: A supportive, nationally recognized organization invested in your success. Income Snapshot The average yearly commission earned among the top 10% of Reporting Publications (the 39 highest earning publications out of 386 total) was $186,062.00. Within this group, the median was $171,717.00, the highest was $344,968.00, and the lowest was $129,673.00. Your financial results may differ. Important assumptions and qualifiers relating to this information can be found in Item 19 of our October 9, 2026 franchise disclosure document. About The N2 Company The N2 Company helps small- to mid-sized businesses connect with affluent homeowners through high-quality monthly publications, targeted digital advertising, and creative community events. Our portfolio includes 800+ custom publications across brands including Stroll, BeLocal, Greet, Real Producers, and more. About Stroll Stroll is a hyperlocal magazine delivered to homeowners in select neighborhoods, featuring the residents, stories, and events that bring each community together. Residents value Stroll for the connection it creates with their neighbors. Local businesses benefit by building trusted relationships with the households they most want to reach. Requirements High school diploma or GED US resident Ability to operate a home-based business with local community engagement

113.title: Installation Technician Helper
113.description: We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party agencies. Resumes submitted without prior approval from our Talent Acquisition team will not be eligible for placement fees. Company Overview At Fortis Fire & Safety, we provide industry-leading fire protection & security services across the United States. Our ever-growing footprint can be seen in California, Florida, North Carolina, and Chicago, and we are acquiring new brands all the time. We are proud to work together as one team under the Fortis Fire & Safety family, which includes CJ Suppression, Diversified Systems, Inc., Integrated Fire & Security Solutions, LaMarco Systems, LifeSafety Management, Piper Fire Protection, and VFS Fire & Security Services. United by a shared mission, we deliver comprehensive fire protection and security solutions nationwide. Joining Fortis means becoming part of a nationwide, next-generation fire protection company. We’re dedicated to a People-First philosophy, where we invest in our team through training and development, as well as a competitive benefits package. In return, we expect the very best from each of our employees every day. If you are ready to be exceptional in your chosen career, apply to work with us today! Here at Fortis and throughout our family of brands, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: Paid vacation and sick time Company Paid Holidays Additional paid time off for life events (e.g., jury duty, bereavement) Competitive compensation 401(k) retirement plan with competitive company match Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance Short-term/Long-term disability insurance Life Insurance Career Advancement Opportunities and more! **This is a general overview of benefits. Specific eligibility and coverage details will be provided during the hiring process** Job Summary: Integrated Fire and Security Solutions is seeking a motivated Security Technician Helper to join our Fort Myers, FL team. This is a physically active, entry-level role supporting the installation of fire alarm and security systems including CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection (IDS) on new construction and retrofit projects across the Fort Myers, Florida region. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in the low-voltage/life safety industry, with on-the-job training and a growth path in the industry. We're looking for a reliable, hands-on worker willing to learn & develop in the trade. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Assist Technicians with the installation of fire alarm and security system components, including mounting devices and panels. Pull cable and run conduit through attics, crawl spaces, ceilings, and other confined or hard-to-access areas. Perform manual labor tasks such as drilling, fishing wire, and mounting equipment. Load, unload, and transport tools, equipment, and materials to and from job sites. Support material staging, tool organization, and jobsite setup/cleanup to keep installations on schedule. Assist with basic wiring and terminations as directed and trained by senior technicians. Help maintain a clean, safe, and organized job site in accordance with company and OSHA safety standards, including proper use of PPE, ladders, and lifts. Learn to read basic blueprints, wiring diagrams, and device layouts under the guidance of senior staff. Communicate professionally with Lead Technicians, Project Managers, and site contacts. Perform other related duties as assigned to support project completion. Required Skills & Qualifications High School Diploma or GED required. Prior experience in general labor, construction, or a related trade; Security or low-voltage industry experience a plus. Ability to follow verbal and written instructions and work safely as part of a team. Basic familiarity with hand and power tools. Willingness to learn low-voltage systems, tools, and industry terminology. Ability to work outdoors and on active construction sites in varying weather conditions. Ability to meet company driving eligibility requirements, including holding a valid driver's license and maintaining an acceptable motor vehicle record. Reliable attendance and punctuality. Preferred Qualifications: OSHA 10 certification (or willingness to obtain). This role may require extended periods of sitting or standing, movement around the office or job site, and operation of standard equipment. Physical activities can include reaching, bending, kneeling, climbing, and lifting up to 75 lbs. Field positions may involve heavy lifting, working in varying climates (including outdoor conditions), construction or low-voltage environments, and exposure to dust, noise, or confined spaces. Personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required. Some roles may require travel. Fortis Fire & Safety Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations are available for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of job-related pre-employment screenings, which may include a background check and/or drug testing, in accordance with applicable laws. 116.title: Account Manager
116.description:
Description

Come build the future of finance with Datarails. We're a global, AI-powered FinanceOS company helping finance teams transform the way they work. By combining intelligent automation, AI, and seamless integrations with the tools finance teams already know and trust, we empower organizations to make faster, smarter decisions with confidence. With approximately 350 employees worldwide, we're building the next generation of finance technology - where innovation, collaboration, and customer success go hand in hand.

If you're looking for a fantastic opportunity to join a growing startup in a role with massive impact, we would love to meet you!

As an Account Manager at Datarails, you’ll be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of existing customer accounts. Your primary focus will be on driving expansion revenue through upsells and cross-sells , fostering long-term relationships, and ensuring customers derive maximum value from the Datarails platform. You’ll work closely with Customer Success Managers to identify growth opportunities and partner with Solutions Consultants or Product as needed to close deals.

This position is 100% remote-based anywhere in the United States. No sponsorship or relocation assistance is available.

What You’ll Do

• Own and manage a book of business across various verticals.

• Develop account growth strategies, including multi-threading key stakeholders.

• Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

• Partner with Customer Success to ensure high levels of product adoption and satisfaction.

• Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to reinforce value and surface new opportunities.

• Forecast expansion pipeline accurately and manage deal progression in Salesforce.

• Collaborate with Marketing and Product to bring feedback from the field and shape go-to-market strategies.

• Maintain a deep understanding of the Datarails platform and FP&A use cases.

Requirements

• 2–4 years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Sales in a SaaS environment.

• Proven track record of driving account growth and achieving expansion quotas.

• Proficient in Salesforce and common SaaS sales tools (e.g., Gong, Outreach, ZoomInfo).

• Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and pipeline hygiene.

• Strong understanding of the finance function—experience selling to CFOs, FP&A teams, or Controllers is a plus.

What We Offer

• Base compensation - The target base salary range will be between $80-100k USD per year, based on multiple factors including prior experience, skills, and location. We are open to candidates with varying levels of experience.

• Meaningful equity

• 401(k) plan with up to 4% match

• Top-of-the-line healthcare (medical, vision, and dental), with 100% paid coverage for employees + generous coverage for dependents

• Parental leave

• Flexible PTO + 12 paid company holidays

• Life insurance And more!

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Datarails recruiters. All legitimate Datarails recruiting communication comes from an @datarails .com email address or a LinkedIn message from a Datarails employee. If you've received a message claiming to be from Datarails that looks suspicious, please forward it to careers@datarails.com

We want to make sure everyone has an equal chance to participate and make a difference. Datarails is an equal opportunity employer and prioritizes building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants of any type and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, genetic information or characteristic, gender identity and expression, veteran status, or other non-job related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state, and local laws. Datarails’ policy is to comply with all applicable laws related to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity and will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

118.description:

You will oversee the management of the office to ensure everything is running smoothly and that our Compass office standards are being maintained. You will support our customers with everything including understanding Compass, training on our tools and programs, assisting with marketing requests and more. Please note: this role is 100% in-office in our Miami Office (1212 Lincoln Road).

•

•
Be a culture carrier who inspires and empowers those around you with a positive and constructive approach to creating and implementing change

What We're Looking For:

•
1-2 years previous experience in customer service, office management, hospitality, or operations

•
Previous experience in real estate a plus

•
Previous experience working with enterprise technology (Zendesk, Salesforce, Confluence) a plus

•
Great listening skills, connects well with others, and is empathetic of the customer’s pain points

•
A passion for creating community within a space; you encourage in-office interaction, bonding and engagement

•
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, allowing you to adapt and formulate solutions quickly

•
Strong verbal communication and presentation skills

•
Meticulous attention to detail, highly organized

•
Ability to work in the office during standard operating hours

Ability to lift up to 25 lbs

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

131.title: School Behavior Technician
131.description:
Join Cortica as a School Behavior Technician
Empower students. Support families. Advance the standard of neurodevelopmental care.

Cortica is seeking a dedicated and compassionate School Behavior Technician (SBT) to provide 1:1 behavior support to students with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences in school settings. You’ll work closely with educators, caregivers, and Cortica’s clinical team to help students succeed across their school day.

Cortica was founded to fix the fragmented journey families often face when seeking therapies for their children. By blending neurology, research-based therapies, and technology into one cohesive care model, we deliver life-changing neurodevelopmental care—one child, one family, one community at a time.

As part of this mission, we proudly partner with local schools to provide ABA therapy in educational settings. This extension of our care reflects our commitment to supporting children not only in clinics and homes, but also in the environments where they learn and grow.

Schedule & Availability
This position follows a consistent Monday–Friday schedule, with required availability from 7:30 AM to 3:45 PM. While actual working hours vary based on student needs, you’ll receive a minimum of 4 hours of paid work per day when you remain available and accept assignments.

At times when you are not yet assigned to a designated client, you may follow an administrative schedule from 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM. During this window, you’ll stay engaged with administrative tasks from home and be ready to step into a school session if one becomes available.

School-Based Role
This role follows the school’s academic calendar and includes unpaid breaks during periods such as Winter Break, Spring Break, and Summer. During the school year, you’ll play a vital role in supporting student success within their educational environments.

What will you do?  

• Execute all responsibilities and skills associated with the Board Certified Autism Technician (BCAT) certification. Must be obtained within 30 days of hire for districts that require certification.

• Provide direct implementation of holistic, neurodiversity-affirming behavior analytic services to students in one-on-one and group settings within schools.

• Implement individualized behavior intervention plans (BIPs) and skill acquisition programs, aligning with the student’s IEP and school goals.

• Work closely with school teams to integrate behavioral strategies into the daily classroom routine and support students’ engagement and learning.

• Support student development in communication, social skills, self-regulation, and self-care (e.g., toileting, hygiene, dressing) as appropriate to the school context.

• Utilize a strengths-based treatment approach developed in collaboration with the educational team.

• Collect data consistently on student progress and behaviors during each session and complete timely documentation, including session notes and incident reports.

• Participate in classroom observations, team meetings, and school-based training sessions as assigned.

• Implement proactive behavior support strategies and follow school safety and crisis protocols, including de-escalation and mandated reporting procedures.

• Travel between assigned work sites, as needed, within the designated service area.

• Other duties as assigned.

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You hold a high school diploma or equivalent.

• You can obtain and maintain Board Certified Autism Technician (BCAT) or Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) credential within 30 days of employment, where required by the district.

• You can obtain assigned safety training certification within 30 days of employment

• You can maintain reliable transportation and must be able to travel between work locations.

• You have a first aid/CPR certification or ability to obtain.

• You have a tuberculosis (TB) clearance.

Your Compensation & Benefits

Cortica cares deeply about the well-being of each member of our team, and we have created a passionate, caring, and growth-minded culture that helps teammates to thrive! We offer a wide range of benefits for full-time teammates, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching and rapid vesting, paid holidays and wellness days, life insurance, disability insurance options, tuition reimbursements for professional development and continuing education, and referral bonuses. We value our teammates and the experience they bring to their roles, and are proud to provide a compensation and benefits package designed to enhance all aspects of our teammates' lives.

The base pay range for this opening is $20.87 to $28.00. According to your relevant experience, education level, and location, you will receive compensation that fits appropriately within the range.

EOE. This posting is not meant to be an exhaustive list of the role and its duties. Please review the job description in the following link: https://tinyurl.com/w6atf8dt
